description: Traffic Control Devices is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Traffic Systems Delivery (TSD) map tracks Traffic Control Devices (TCDs) that are upcoming or recently activated. Currently TSD has data available for the following TCDs, more will be added as we expand our data set: Traffic Signals PXO Beacons. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are pedestrian crossover, traffic control devices, traffic signals. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
